geometer.label: After Blake, The Ancient of Days
geometer.verse: When he set a compass upon the face of the depth.

light.label: After Doré, The Creation of Light
light.verse: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.

spirit.label: The dove upon the waters
spirit.verse: And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.

walking.label: After Aivazovsky, Walking on Water
walking.verse: Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.

bow.label: After Koch, Noah’s Thank Offering
bow.verse: I do set my bow in the cloud.

still.label: After Rembrandt, The Storm on the Sea of Galilee
still.verse: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still.

ladder.label: After Blake, Jacob’s Dream
ladder.verse: Behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven.

leviathan.label: After Doré, The Destruction of Leviathan
leviathan.verse: He shall slay the dragon that is in the sea.

morning.label: After Blake, When the Morning Stars Sang Together
morning.verse: When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy.

whirlwind.label: After Blake, The Lord Answering Job out of the Whirlwind
whirlwind.verse: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth?

wisdom.label: Wisdom before the world
wisdom.verse: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was.

jonah.label: After Doré, Jonah Cast Forth by the Whale
jonah.verse: All thy billows and thy waves passed over me.

ark.label: The ark upon the flood
ark.verse: And the ark went upon the face of the waters.

lights.label: After Michelangelo, The Creation of the Sun and Moon

chariot.label: Elijah taken up in the chariot of fire
chariot.verse: And Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.
